summary: A double-click on inline code in desktop chat markdown selects the whole span, so a command, flag or path with hyphens, dots or slashes copies in one step.

reactNativeIos.reason: apps/mobile renders chat markdown as non-selectable Text inside a Pressable whose long press shows the turn time, so there is no word selection to widen; making message text selectable is a separate feature.

nativeAndroid.reason: ThreadRichTextRenderer.kt chat text is not in a SelectionContainer and a long press on a turn forks the conversation or shows the turn time, so there is no word selection to widen; making message text selectable is a separate feature.

sharedBackendApi.reason: Renderer-only DOM selection change; no wire message, event or API changes.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data; the selection is transient browser state.

updateRelease.reason: Unconditional desktop renderer fix with no flag, identity, signing, deep-link or update-channel change.

automated: npx vitest run tests/unit/inline-code-dblclick.test.ts (fails without the onDoubleClick wiring)
notExercised: Not exercised in a running Electron window; jsdom dispatches the dblclick after a simulated word selection, which is the order Chromium uses (word selection on the second mousedown, dblclick after mouseup).
Phones are not applicable: their chat text has no word selection.
